name: jobvault
description: Password manager and application tracker for job hunting, for Chrome and Brave.

scripts.check: for f in background.js content.js popup.js dashboard.js lib/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && python3 -m py_compile native/jobvault_updater.py && echo ok
scripts.package: rm -f jobvault.zip && zip -r jobvault.zip manifest.json build.json background.js content.js popup.html popup.css popup.js dashboard.html dashboard.css dashboard.js lib icons scripts native README.md CHANGELOG.md LICENSE -x '*__pycache__*'

author: Kaushal Bhingaradia
